description: Subscribe to verified programme-change alerts (price changes, launches, corrections — each linked to the official source). Agents: provide webhook_url (HTTPS POST on each change). Humans: provide email (explicit consent required). Optional programme_ids filter. Returns a subscription id + unsubscribe URL. Webhook POSTs carry X-Mirabello-Signature: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body keyed with your subscription id>. Each call creates a separate subscription, so repeating it duplicates the alerts.

consent.description: required true when email is given (GDPR)

webhook_url.description: HTTPS endpoint to POST change entries to (for agents/systems)

name: subscribe_changes

outputSchema.description: Mirabello envelope; tool fields vary; error only on failure.

title: Subscribe to Programme-Change Alerts
